arguments.recommended_next_step: Conduct a thorough review of the certificate management process to prevent future expiration issues. Schedule a meeting with the team to discuss best practices for cron job scheduling and ensure alignment with UTC time. Continue monitoring the system for any further issues and prepare a detailed postmortem report using the exported failed_jobs table.
arguments.summary: Investigated the cause of the 502s on the checkout page and determined it was due to the ingress idle timeout. Identified that the intermediate certificate had expired, which was causing issues with SSL/TLS. Resolved the cron job scheduling issue by ensuring it operates on UTC time. Discovered a backlog of 47 malformed jobs in the failed_jobs table, which was blocking the retry queue. Deleted these rows to unblock the queue immediately. The pgbouncer service and disk usage checks are pending confirmation from P17.
